changes.discard: Adds before/after canonical scripts+authoring buildInput identity and exact capture manifest, audit and inventory byte identities. The strict preview provider still validates admission, its returned pins/source identities must equal these preflight values. Existing full runtime, scoped helper, HEAD and probe checks remain.
changes.offline: After bounded browser shutdown, close the preview with a2000ms bound; record attempted/completed/error/elapsed, preserve primaryfailure and save receipt even if serverclose fails.

scope: Canonical scripts/authoring scope is the same full selected producer-input scope verified by openEmittedPreview: sorted rg --files scripts authoring, .mjs/.js/.json/.css/.html excluding /test/, *.test.mjs and */coverage.json, SHA256(path + NUL + raw SHA256(bytes)). No claim that unselected binaries or every repository file are included. The ignored evidence helper and probe are additionally pinned.

independentReadOnlyReview.result: No blocker; strict provider admission is supplemented by exact before/after evidence pins; server close remains bounded after browser close, preserves primary failure, and is itself pinned.

limitations: Preparation grants no browser qualification credit. Await final capture and explicit browser-slot release.
Binding samples before and after detect boundary changes, not transient edits reverted between samples.
An elapsed server-close deadline is a strict failure even if a late callback eventually completes. No timeout is relaxed.
